name: The Job Forum
description: Free weekly virtual job search advice, workshops, and one-on-one career coaching
fullDescription: The Job Forum is a free, volunteer-run San Francisco Bay Area nonprofit (sponsored by the San Francisco Chamber of Commerce Foundation) where local managers, recruiters, and career coaches give job seekers advice in virtual sessions every week.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free weekly virtual advice meetings on Wednesdays (Zoom)
- Thursday virtual workshops with industry experts
- One-on-one advising with managers, recruiters, and career coaches
- Resume, LinkedIn, and interview help
- Referrals and contacts inside Bay Area companies
- Workforce of the Future program for young people ages 15-25
howToGetIt:
1. Visit The Job Forum website
2. Sign up for free sessions through Eventbrite
3. Join the virtual meetings and workshops on Zoom
4. Request one-on-one advising with a volunteer panelist
keywords: Job Forum, San Francisco, free networking, job search, resume workshop, LinkedIn, interview prep, career transition, job seeker, peer support
